inputs.text: A 2D anime game bard performing her lament skill, a continuous repeating musical performance animation. The adult female bard Ere keeps the exact original right-facing three-quarter pose, eyes softly closed and chin lifted as she sings with the original narrow open mouth. Preserve her chestnut braid, embroidered black cap and veil, ivory sleeves, burgundy and black layered skirt, star jewelry and brown boots. She holds ONE wooden pear-shaped lute across her chest; her left hand stays wrapped around the SAME upper frets and the right wrist performs two or three CLEAR visible down-up strumming gestures across the strings over the rosette. Her right elbow opens, the wrist sweeps down across the strings and returns; the hand does NOT leave the wooden soundboard area. Her chest expands and rises on the musical phrase, shoulders and lute rise together, then her knees flex gently and the full body settles before the next phrase. A graceful confident connected performance, not an idle mannequin, not a dancing spin. The instrument moves as ONE RIGID object following the torso and arms. The pear body, rosette, straight neck, straight parallel strings and tuning pegs never change shape or length. The braid, veil, sleeve cuffs, skirt hems, gold chains and lute ribbon follow the musical upper-body movement with soft natural delay. Both boots remain firmly planted at the exact same ground positions. No steps, no jumping, no turning, no forward travel. Keep her eyes closed and mouth small throughout, no exaggerated lip sync. Same face, same costume and colors. No floating music notes, no magical effects, no glow, no particles: the game adds the gift effect later. Fixed camera, no zoom, full body and both boots always visible, plain solid green background.
